read.thesis: Vertiv raised FY26 sales guidance to $14B (+$250M) and Q3 sales to $3.75B midpoint, but Q2 revenue slipped on project timing and supply-chain congestion, with EMEA organic down 2%.

capex.quote: we now expect to be at the high end of our range 4% of 2026 sales, As we further expand the global capabilities and capacity going into 2027.

triggers.label: Capex at high end of 4% of sales
triggers.quote: we now expect to be at the high end of our range 4% of 2026 sales, As we further expand the global capabilities and capacity going into 2027.
triggers.highlight: high end of our range 4% of 2026 sales

triggers.label: FY26 sales raised by $250M to $14B
triggers.quote: For net sales, we now expect $14 billion at the midpoint. that is up $3.77 billion or 37% versus 2025. This represents an increase of $250 million versus our prior guidance.
triggers.highlight: This represents an increase of $250 million versus our prior guidance

triggers.label: Q2 revenue timing shifts from execution
triggers.quote: We experienced some minor timing shifts in Q2 revenue, primarily driven by multiphase project execution and temporary supply chain dynamics.
triggers.highlight: minor timing shifts in Q2 revenue

triggers.label: Positive price-cost expected in 2026
triggers.quote: We expect positive price cost in 2026, including the current impact of tariffs and countermeasures.
triggers.highlight: We expect positive price cost in 2026

triggers.label: Inventory up 73% to $2.52B
triggers.quote: Inventory -- $2.523 billion, an increase from $1.457 billion at year-end 2025 to support the projected second-half production ramp.
triggers.highlight: to support the projected second-half production ramp
